review_scope: Source-PDF visual audit, not a modification to Development gold. Three explicitly table-labelled gold pages form the table metric. Other observations are diagnostic samples, not whole-corpus accuracy.
method: Rendered frozen PDFs with PyMuPDF at 1.4 scale; inspected original pages and saved parser records. Reproducible anchor/order/cell checks accompany visual findings. No LLM-generated quality score is used as sole evaluator.
